description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Detects WRONG-VALUE parity: the validation/accounting component is PRESENT but fed a different semantic value/identity than its sibling/correct counterpart. Distinct from asset_source_consistency (which compares asset-source FAMILIES for transfer-source mismatch) — this lens compares curated IDENTIFIER ALIAS-PAIRS for check-vs-use / threshold-name mismatch. Anchored on Size M-02 (validateSellCreditMarket guards `params.amount < minimumCreditBorrowAToken` — a cash amount checked against a CREDIT-named threshold; the derived creditAmount is what should be checked). Wrong-value detection is semantic and FP-prone, so this lens is deliberately narrow (curated alias vocab, two-context split required) and high-precision-over-recall. NEVER mints or routes.

fp_controls.curated_alias_only: candidates require a member of a curated identity_alias_pairs / value_alias_pairs entry — never arbitrary identifier diffs
fp_controls.two_context_split: shape 1 (identity check-vs-use) is LOW-only / never routable: corpus eval showed its premise is weak — checking msg.sender/owner while sending to recipient/receiver is the NORMAL ERC20/ERC4626 transfer pattern, not a bug. Kept as research context only; the routable signal is shape 2 (threshold_value_mismatch).
fp_controls.threshold_name_mismatch: shape 2 fires only when a guard compares a raw-alias operand against an identifier whose NAME carries the paired derived keyword (e.g. amount < minimumCredit...) — the threshold-name mismatch is the signal
fp_controls.net_gross_low_only: shape 3 (return V vs transfer V+/-fee) is emitted at LOW confidence only, never routable
fp_controls.not_asset_source: this lens does NOT flag asset-source-FAMILY mismatch (collateral/supply/native/token transfer-source) — that is asset_source_consistency's territory
fp_controls.wrapper_admin_view_suppression: reuse forwarder/both-admin suppression from the parity machinery
